rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges hatching/ICM/TE features, but it overstates certainty from a single image and includes likely fabricated details such as a clearly well-formed fully expanded blastocoel, uniform TE, normal granularity, and a polar body/cellular fragment not confidently identifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, unexplained infertility, prior failed cycle, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear attempt to connect morphology, age-related euploidy, and endometrial factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and overprecision in probability derivation.

Mostly aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but it overendorses PGT-A and ERA for future failure scenarios and includes controversial/low-value tests such as NK cells, MTHFR, thrombophilia workup, growth hormone, and broad adjunct supplements without strong guideline support.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer, luteal support, post-transfer care, and contingency planning, though some suggested future investigations/interventions are more speculative than guideline-driven.
